candidates.claim_screen: Two independent fresh-context reviews on November 16 accepted the statement, and machine-checked consistency lemmas accompany it. A bounded literature search on November 16 found the three-dimensional cutoff-free deterministic case stated as open through September 2026, with no proof or claim. Known results need a truncated force, added noise, dimension two with strictly positive data, or monokinetic data. Point particles in three-space under the repulsive Coulomb force scaled by one over their number, started from independent samples of a smooth compactly supported density, have empirical averages converging in probability at each fixed time to those of the classical Vlasov–Poisson solution, with no cutoff and no noise. The existence of that solution is a known theorem included in the statement. A theorem for another data class, for the torus or for short times does not by itself settle it. It is a modern instance of the particle-to-continuum programme associated with Hilbert 6, not the problem itself.
